title: deck.updated
description: Sets a subset of a deck's registers, all at the op's hlc. OPS.md#deckupdated

id.description: Id of the deck. Equals the envelope's entity_id.

set.description: Registers to write. At least one.

new_cards_per_day.description: Per-deck daily new-card limit; null = only the global limit applies.

reviews_per_day.description: Per-deck daily review limit; null = only the global limit applies.

query.description: Register 'query'. Only valid for smart decks (server rejects otherwise).

settings.description: Open object; each top-level key is its own register 'settings.<key>'. Known keys: order, add_kanji, card_kinds. A null value removes the key (the register keeps its clock).
